cover.title: 5 niche ways to become the founder european chatgpt users find first

inner.title: let the search bot in
inner.body: openai's oai-searchbot decides if you show up in chatgpt search. blocking gptbot does not remove you, but opting out of oai-searchbot does.

inner.title: open bing webmaster tools
inner.body: openai names bing as one of the providers behind chatgpt search. if you only ever check google, you are guessing about your best channel.

inner.title: match english queries
inner.body: in one alice labs scan, 187 of 299 searches chatgpt ran for swedish questions were in english. a page that exists only in your language may never match.

inner.title: put the question in the title
inner.body: in that scan, pages with the question's wording in the title and a short early answer got cited more. a clever headline loses to a plain one.

inner.title: tag the visits
inner.body: openai says chatgpt referral links carry utm_source=chatgpt.com. filter it in ga4, or you will never know europe found you.

closer.HEADLINE:
europe asks chatgpt first.
be the answer.
